title: Boundary-Sensitive Pre-Training for Temporal Localization in Videos

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Due to the difficulties in collecting a largescale video dataset with temporal boundary annotations, we propose to synthesize large-scale untrimmed videos with boundary annotations by transforming the existing trimmed video action classification datasets.
